plan.title: Add a question in RFP Form View

steps.note: Open the single-stage create screen for the RFP setup.
Provide the required event title for the create flow.
Apply the available RFP template before editing its questionnaire.

args.goal: In the RFP questionnaire Form View, click Add New Question, enter Question 'KB integration question', Description 'Question added through Form View', Field Type 'Text', set Required to Yes, click the blue Add button, and stop on the form showing the saved question with its description, type, and required state

steps.note: Perform the question-builder interaction and finish on the saved question so the result is observable.
Verify the newly added question appears in the form.
Verify the saved description is displayed.
Verify the saved field type is displayed.
Verify the saved required-state indicator is displayed.
